notes: Added API/revocation, integration, and test coverage stories to complete lifecycle.

stories.title: Token Revocation API and Enforcement
stories.description: Implement revocation capability including API endpoint or internal function to revoke tokens by token_id or hash. Update authentication flow to deny revoked tokens and persist revocation_reason and timestamp for audit.

stories.title: Authentication Middleware Integration
stories.description: Integrate expiration, rotation, and revocation checks into the GPTReader authentication path ensuring every request validates token status before data access. Maintain compatibility with existing bearer token validation flow.

stories.title: Audit Logging for Token Lifecycle Events
stories.description: Extend audit logging to capture token issuance, rotation, expiration rejection, and revocation events with sufficient metadata for traceability and security review.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Token Lifecycle
stories.description: Create comprehensive tests covering token expiration, rotation lineage, revocation enforcement, and authentication integration including edge cases such as expired-then-rotated tokens and revoked active tokens.
